penalty_lines: Changes in unrecognized tax benefits, inclusive of interest and penalties
penalty_evidence: This is a change in the UTP reserve. Footnote (2) to the UTP liability rollforward states that the Company 'has taken a position that IRC Section 280E does not preclude it from deducting ordinary and necessary business expenditures' and that 'As of December 31, 2025, $ 630.3 million is related to this tax position'. That ties a stated dollar portion of the reserve to 280E, but no marker on the reconciliation line itself does.
section_280e_quotes: The IRS has taken the position that cannabis companies are subject to the limits of Internal Revenue Code ("IRC") Section 280E for U.S. federal income tax purposes.
The Company has taken a position that Section 280E does not preclude it from deducting ordinary and necessary business expenditures on its tax returns.

Of the $ 75.3 million and $ 29.6 million in accrued interest as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, $ 65.8 million and $ 23.5 million relates to the Company's IRC Section 280E tax position, as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
extraction_notes: All figures are in thousands. Net income is the consolidated 'Net loss' of (122,248), before non-controlling interest allocation. It includes a net loss from discontinued operations of (5,612); the net loss from continuing operations was (116,636). Pre-tax income (91,473) and tax expense (208,109) relate to continuing operations. The 2025 reconciliation follows ASU 2023-09 and shows amounts and percentages. It does not print a pre-tax income row, so the reconciliation pretax_income is null. The 91,473 figure appears in the income statement and in the separate domestic/foreign pre-tax table. The sub-lines sum exactly to the 208,109 total. There is no explicit Section 280E line in the reconciliation. The company files as if 280E does not apply, so the 280E cost appears within 'Changes in unrecognized tax benefits, inclusive of interest and penalties' (172,804; 188.9%). That line is not itself footnoted as 280E; the tie is at the reserve level: $630.3 million of the $668,375 thousand UTP liability relates to the 280E position, plus $65.8 million of accrued interest. The footnote presents two different rollforwards: unrecognized tax benefits ending at 808,631 and uncertain tax position liabilities ending at 668,375. Neither reconciles directly to the 172,804 reconciliation line. There is no separate valuation allowance line in the 2025 reconciliation, although the allowance rollforward shows 173 charged to costs and expenses; any such effect is presumably within other lines. Proposed IRS penalties of about $38.1 million are not included in the UTP liability. The 2024 and 2023 columns use the pre-ASU 2023-09 format and were ignored.

penalty_evidence: UTP reserve increase whose footnote marker (3) reads "Primarily related to the Company's Section 280E Position."
section_280e_quotes: (3) Primarily related to the Company's Section 280E Position.
extraction_notes: All figures are in thousands of USD for FY ended 2025-12-31. Tax expense: the statement of operations prints the provision as (123,689) because it is deducted from pre-tax loss; the footnote shows it as expense of $123,689, so it is reported as positive 123,689. Net income uses the consolidated 'Net loss' line of (228,153), which is before NCI and includes the (26,250) loss from discontinued operations; net loss from continuing operations is (201,903). Pre-tax income: the reconciliation starts from tax at the statutory rate and does not print a pre-tax figure, so the reconciliation pretax_income is null. The income statement and footnote components table show (78,214). Percentages in the reconciliation are printed rounded to whole numbers; the effective tax rate is (158)%. The printed line amounts sum to the $123,689 total. ASU 2023-09 was adopted prospectively for 2025, so the 2024 reconciliation uses different captions and was not recast. Section 280E is mentioned only in footnote marker (3) on the 'Increase in uncertain tax position' line ($97,843, (125)%), which is 'Primarily related to the Company's Section 280E Position'. The 280E cost is therefore embedded mainly in the UTP line, not in 'Non-deductible expenses' ($3,117). The UTP line is not wholly 280E; the non-280E portion is not quantified. uncertain_tax_position_on_280e is set to true based on the 'Section 280E Position' language tying the UTP increase to 280E. The footnote does not explicitly state that returns or refund claims were filed treating 280E as inapplicable. The unrecognized tax benefits rollforward shows $36,389 of 'refunds requested but not yet received' and $16,176 of 'refunds received', but these rows are not labelled 280E. The UTP rollforward runs from $432,341 to $587,826, and $586.0 million would affect the effective tax rate if recognized. 'Penalties and interest' ($1,593) is classified as other. The footnote separately states accrued interest and penalties for uncertain tax positions of $25.4 million within the Provision for income taxes and $69.8 million within Other long-term liabilities; these do not reconcile directly to the $1,593 reconciliation line.

penalty_evidence: This is an unrecognized-tax-benefit reserve line, and the footnote says only generally that 280E 'results in unrecognized tax benefits which can cause the effective tax rate to be highly variable' without identifying the reserve, its rollforward or any amount as the 280E position.
section_280e_quotes: As the Company operates in the cannabis industry, the IRS contends the Company is subject to IRC Section 280E under which the Company is only allowed to deduct expenses directly related to sales of product.
This results in unrecognized tax benefits which can cause the effective tax rate to be highly variable and may not necessarily correlate with pre-tax income or loss.
extraction_notes: All figures are in thousands of USD for FY2025. Consolidated net income before NCI is 116,053; net income attributable to GTI is 114,152. The rate reconciliation does not print a pre-tax income line, so rate_reconciliation.pretax_income is null (statement pretax income is 263,355). The reconciling lines sum exactly to the 147,302 total, and the 55.93% effective rate is printed. There is no separate Section 280E line. The 280E effect is not disaggregated and appears to be embedded in 'Changes in Unrecognized Tax Benefits' (75,030; 28.49%) and possibly in 'Nontaxable or Nondeductible Items' (10,110; 3.84%). The footnote ties 280E to unrecognized tax benefits only in general terms. The UTB rollforward shows a balance of 76,782 at the beginning of the year and 203,348 at the end, with no 280E-labelled row. Accrued interest and penalties total 25,207, and 22,806 of unrecognized tax benefits are expected to be recovered within 12 months. uncertain_tax_position_on_280e=true is an inference, not an explicit statement. The footnote does not expressly say that returns were filed treating 280E as inapplicable. Instead it states that the IRS contends 280E applies and that this results in unrecognized tax benefits, which implies the company takes a filing position contrary to 280E. 'Other Adjustments - States' (1,445) is classified as other rather than state_local because it is presented separately from the state and local tax line; analysts may choose to combine them. Income taxes paid in 2025 were 30,214, well below current tax expense of 128,582, which is consistent with UTB accrual.

net_income_label: Net Loss Attributable to Verano Holdings Corp. & Subsidiaries
penalty_lines: Uncertain Tax Positions, including penalties and interest
penalty_evidence: UTP reserve line; the footnote identifies the reserve as the 280E position: 'recorded an uncertain tax liability ... for tax positions taken based on legal interpretations that challenge the Company's tax liability under Section 280E of the Code ("280E Position")' and 'recorded additional uncertain tax liabilities associated with this position and reflected in the tables below' (the rollforwards), but the reconciliation line itself carries no 280E label or marker.
section_280e_quotes: The IRS has taken the position that cannabis companies are subject to the limits of Section 280E of the Code for U.S. federal income tax purposes, under which, they are only allowed to deduct expenses directly related to costs of goods sold.
The Company has taken a position that its deduction of ordinary and necessary business expenses is not limited by Section 280E of the Code.

During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company recorded an uncertain tax liability in uncertain tax positions on the Consolidated Balance Sheet for tax positions taken based on legal interpretations that challenge the Company's tax liability under Section 280E of the Code (“280E Position”).
extraction_notes: Unit scale: the excerpted table headers do not state the scale; unit_multiplier=1000 (thousands) is inferred from internal consistency (net loss $257,908 / 360.9M weighted shares = $0.71 per share as printed) and should be verified against the filing header. Net income: no separate consolidated net loss line exists; the only bottom line is 'Net Loss Attributable to Verano Holdings Corp. & Subsidiaries' (-257,908), used as net_income; the pre-tax line is captioned 'before Provision for Income Taxes and Non-Controlling Interest'. Income tax expense is printed on the statement as (91,678) (deducted from pre-tax loss) but is an expense per the footnote total ($91,678), so reported as +91,678. FY2025 reconciliation adopted ASU 2023-09 prospectively; 2024/2023 comparatives are in the old format (2023 showed an explicit 'Nondeductible 280E' line of 79,731; 2024 and 2025 instead show the 280E cost via the uncertain tax position line). 'Nontaxable or Nondeductible Items' is a header with no amount; its sub-lines are reported individually. The UTP line (113,291; -68.1%) includes penalties and interest (rollforward shows $37,214 interest and penalties on UTPs in 2025) and is the principal 280E cost, but no line is labelled 280E; hence no section_280e line. Percentages are reported as printed: because pre-tax result is a loss, items increasing expense show negative rates; effective rate is (55.2)%. Footnote (1) on the statutory line states Florida state taxes make up the majority of 'this category' (placement appears to relate to state taxes). Line amounts sum exactly to the $91,678 total. Gross unrecognized tax benefits were $473,664 and uncertain tax liabilities $378,261 at 12/31/2025; company is under IRS audit for 2021-2022.

penalty_evidence: The unrecognized tax benefit rollforward's only addition row is labelled 'IRS Section 280E Positions' (10,870), and the footnote states the reserve relates to 'tax positions based on legal interpretations that challenge the Company's tax liability under Section 280E.'
section_280e_quotes: As the Company operates in the legalized cannabis industry, it is subject to the limits of Internal Revenue Code (“IRC”) Section 280E (“Section 280E”) for U.S. federal income tax purposes under which the Company is only allowed to deduct certain expenses directly related to the cost of goods sold.
Based on legal interpretation, it is the Company’s position that it does not owe taxes attributable to the application of Section 280E.

The Company included in the balance of total unrecognized tax benefits as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 a potential benefit of $31.7 million and $20.9 million, respectively, that, if recognized, would impact the effective tax rate on income from operations related to its tax positions based on legal interpretations that challenge the Company’s tax liability under Section 280E.
extraction_notes: All figures are in USD thousands. Net income is the consolidated line (-28,952) before the NCI allocation of 707; the amount attributable to the Company is -29,659. The reconciliation does not print pre-tax income, so pretax_income is null; the statutory line (-3,574 at 21.0%) is consistent with the income-statement pre-tax loss of -17,018. Because pre-tax income is a loss, printed percentages carry the opposite sign to the amounts (e.g. the UTB line is +10,870 but -63.9%); amounts are reported as printed and already follow the expense-positive convention. The effective rate is (70.1)%. Two heading rows carry no values and were omitted from line_items: 'Effect of Changes in Tax Laws or Rates Enacted in the Current Period' (sub-lines Over Accrual of Prior Year Taxes and Return to Provision) and 'Nontaxable or Nondeductible Items' (sub-lines reported individually). The heading 'Changes in Valuation Allowances' is also a header only. The 2025 line items sum to the 11,934 total. No line is labelled Section 280E. The 280E cost appears through 'Changes in Unrecognized Tax Benefits' (10,870), which exactly equals the rollforward row 'IRS Section 280E Positions' (10,870). The UTB balance was 31,738 at year end, and the narrative ties $31.7 million to 280E positions. The large unexplained 'Other' line (6,006; -35.3%) and 'Other Permanent Differences' (534) may embed additional 280E or permanent-difference effects, but the filing does not say so. All tax is current; there is no deferred expense and deferred tax is net zero after a full valuation allowance of 40,995. Disclosed EPS (-0.55) is not relevant to this extraction.
